context: Headline audit: applies the hard-stop marker scan across a dense Java 17 class and classifies both required fixes and legitimate markers.

checklist.name: Creates review artifact
checklist.description: Creates review.md with a clear hard-stop audit.

checklist.name: Flags count existence check
checklist.description: Flags filter(...).count() > 0 in hasActive and recommends anyMatch.

checklist.name: Flags collect-isEmpty existence check
checklist.description: Flags collect(toList()).isEmpty() in missingPrimary and recommends noneMatch or !anyMatch.

checklist.name: Flags sorted-findFirst extreme
checklist.description: Flags sorted(...).findFirst() in newest and recommends max with the same comparator semantics.

checklist.name: Flags collect-then-join
checklist.description: Flags collecting display names only to pass them to String.join and recommends Collectors.joining.

checklist.name: Flags Stream.toList mutability break
checklist.description: Flags activeIds because Stream.toList() returns an unmodifiable list that is later mutated.

checklist.name: Flags parallel findAny priority break
checklist.description: Flags configuredPrimary because parallelStream plus findAny can ignore configured encounter-order priority; recommends stream().findFirst() or the loop.

checklist.name: Flags duplicate toMap risk
checklist.description: Flags byEmail because duplicate emails are possible and toMap needs an explicit merge policy.

checklist.name: Flags nullable groupingBy classifier
checklist.description: Flags byRegion because region can be null and null classifier keys must be filtered or mapped explicitly.

checklist.name: Flags nullable natural sort
checklist.description: Flags sortedDiscountCodes because null discount codes can reach Comparator.naturalOrder.

checklist.name: Flags top-N limit ordering
checklist.description: Flags topThreeBySpend because limit occurs before sorting, so it does not compute the global top three.

checklist.name: Flags Optional get pattern
checklist.description: Flags filter(Optional::isPresent).map(Optional::get) and recommends flatMap(Optional::stream) on Java 17.

checklist.name: Classifies BigDecimal reduce as acceptable
checklist.description: Mentions totalSpend as a scan-adjacent reduction that should remain BigDecimal reduce rather than primitive aggregation.

checklist.name: Keeps audit concise
checklist.description: Does not rewrite the class wholesale or add unrelated Java style feedback.
